name: S.P. Apparels Ltd
statement: Current consolidated order book INR474 crores
quote: Our current order book stands at INR474 crores as of now.
speaker: mgmt
note: Matches quote on current order book value.

name: S.P. Apparels Ltd
statement: Customers forcing shift to Sri Lanka production; order book not an issue
quote: So, the reason is the customers are forcing us to take Sri Lanka production. So that's the way it goes. I don't see any risk in terms of filling the capacity.
speaker: mgmt
note: Supports customers forcing Sri Lanka production and no capacity risk.

name: S.P. Apparels Ltd
statement: Sri Lanka operations to run 1,000 machines adding INR200 crores revenue in FY26
quote: So, which means that we expect FY26 the Sri Lanka operation alone, we will be able to run about 1,000 machines, which can bring about INR200 crores as an additional business in the top line.
speaker: mgmt
note: Fully matches FY26 Sri Lanka machine count and revenue.

name: S.P. Apparels Ltd
statement: Standalone gross debt INR208 crores, net debt INR187 crores
value: INR208 crores gross, INR187 crores net
quote: Our current debt position as on the standalone basis stood at INR208 crores gross debt, and the net debt is INR187 crores.
speaker: mgmt
note: Matches gross and net standalone debt values.

name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
statement: Focused on profitable product and customer mix, exited low-profit segments
quote: we had a very clear strategy on where to go or where to play, right, which meant that there were some businesses that we were doing, which were not profitable or low profitability or segments where we thought we were not well positioned. So we cautiously took a decision not to play with them.
speaker: mgmt
note: Supports strategy of exiting low-profit segments in 2025.

name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
statement: Solvent consumption reduced across all sites in Q4 CY25 improving worker safety and emissions
quote: In quarter 4 last year, we reduced solvent consumption across all our sites, which made improvement on our worker environment and safety while also reducing the emissions.
speaker: mgmt
note: Matches solvent reduction and safety improvements in Q4 last year.

name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
statement: Labour code notification Nov 2024; proactive actions taken, no significant impact expected
quote: you would have seen notification on labour code, which came out on 21st of November last year, which is actually a very important development. I'm actually pleased to tell you that we actually took some proactive actions in recent past particularly in relation to employee liabilities. So we expect not a very significant impact to our business moving forward.
speaker: mgmt
note: Supports proactive actions on labour code and minimal impact.

name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
statement: US exposure only 1% of sales (INR24bn); minimal impact from US-India trade deal
quote: our total impact is only 1% of our sales. So if we say our INR2,400 crores top line, only 1% of that business is through U.S.
speaker: mgmt
note: Matches 1% US sales exposure and INR2,400 crores top line.

name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
statement: Won prestigious order from Indian Navy to develop 6-megawatt engine for marine main propulsion with IP rights held in India
quote: This is a prestigious order that we won last year from the Indian Navy to develop a 6-megawatt engine for marine main propulsion.
speaker: mgmt
note: Matches Indian Navy order for 6-megawatt engine.

name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
statement: Standalone EBITDA margin expanded 110 bps to 12.8% in FY25; PAT margin expanded to 8.1%
quote: On EBITDA side, again, you can see that 100 basis point expansion. So for FY '25, our EBITDA was 12.8% compared to last financial year, it was 11.7%.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote states 12.8% vs 11.7% (110 bps), PAT margin 8.1% not explicitly tied to expansion in quote.

name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
statement: HHP competition well entrenched; Optiprime 1000 kVA offers smallest footprint, 10-15% better fuel consumption, 20-25% cheaper oil/filter changes, inbuilt redundancy
quote: Fuel consumption will be at least 10%- 15% better. So like Gauri mentioned, there is inbuilt load balancing that happens. So it will operate at the appropriate optimal load for the Genset irrespective of the overall Genset load.
speaker: mgmt
note: Matches 10-15% better fuel consumption statement.

name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
statement: BS V transition led to average 20% price increase; CPCB IV+ pricing still maturing but seeing stability
quote: Renu Baid Pugalia: An average increase in the pricing in this BS V segment for us? Gauri Kirloskar: 20%.
speaker: mgmt
note: Matches 20% price increase in BS V segment.

name: AVP Infracon Limited
statement: Trade receivables high due to Q4 billing concentration; expects INR200-250 crore receivables at INR1000 crore revenue
quote: Considering the debtor days, whatever it is for a company performing INR1,000 crores, we can take at least INR200 crores to INR250 crores, that can be INR250 crores at least to be in this unbilled revenue, or I mean debtor trade receivables.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote explicitly states INR200-250 cr trade receivables for INR1000 cr.

name: AVP Infracon Limited
statement: Target debt-to-equity below 1.5x (currently 1.23x); promoter warrant subscription INR22.5 cr pending
quote: Sir, we'll try to keep it below 1.5. But again, if equity raise is not happening because of the share market, it might go up. That also does not comment, but we'll always try to keep it below 1.5. Right now, it is 1.23 for us.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote states below 1.5 and 1.23; FY27 period is not in quote.

name: AVP Infracon Limited
statement: Ind AS adoption expected to reduce inventory days by recognizing unbilled revenue
quote: Once we start following Ind AS, unbilled will become a part of revenue itself, sir. So inventory days will automatically come down because, sir, our inventory is somewhere in the range from INR15 crores to INR20 crores, actually, not more than that.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms Ind AS adoption reduces inventory days via unbilled revenue.

name: AVP Infracon Limited
statement: Cash flow from operations negative for 3 years; working capital funded by debt/equity
quote: We do not claim that we have been operationally positive for the past 3 years. For a growing company like us, you cannot expect 100% operationally positive things. We are trying our level best to bring it to an operationally positive.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote mentions not operationally positive past 3 years; FY26 period missing.

name: Globus Spirits Limited
statement: FCI policy change stopped rice allocation to distilleries; government not reversing policy; OMC prices revised with MSP changes
quote: the government has now created a policy, well, not now, but last year, where the FCI rice surplus stock will not be given to distilleries.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote mentions FCI policy on rice; MSP and OMC parts not supported.

name: Globus Spirits Limited
statement: Net revenue Rs. 642 crores, up 13% YoY and 6% QoQ; EBITDA margin 8% vs 4% in Q4; net debt Rs. 331 crores, up 35% QoQ and 31% YoY
quote: As a result of the above, the EBITDA margin is at 8%, which for Q4 was at 4%.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote supports EBITDA margin 8% and Q4 4%; other revenue/debt stats missing.

name: Globus Spirits Limited
statement: Distribution strategy: 7 states for mainstream brands, luxury-only states like Goa; focus on strengthening route-to-market in existing 7 states this year
quote: at this point of time, this year, we are expecting that we will more or less remain with these 7 states. And towards the end of the financial year, we will start speeding work on a couple of states which will go through their initial phases in the coming years.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms remaining with 7 states this year and strengthening route.

name: Globus Spirits Limited
statement: Maize cultivation area up ~20% in current Kharif; expecting further growth; 24 months for sufficient maize supply
quote: We are seeing in the current year, almost close to 20% increase in area under cultivation for maize.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote mentions ~20% maize area increase; 24 months duration not supported.

name: Havells India Limited
statement: Invested Rs 600 crores in Goldi Solar during the year to leverage solar module manufacturing capabilities
quote: As you would be aware, during the year, we invested Rs 600 crores in Goldi Solar. This investment allows us to leverage Goldi's solar module manufacturing capabilities to expand our solar portfolio.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote explicitly states Rs 600 crores invested in Goldi Solar during the year.

name: Havells India Limited
statement: Pre-buying in March for cooling products accentuated by price increase announcements; typical seasonal pattern
quote: On the first part yes there was some pre -buying in March, especially in cooling products. But generally that is the case also in most of the years because it's also the upcoming season time for April and May. So but that was also accentuated by the fact that the price increases were happening.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms pre-buying in March for cooling products due to price increases.

name: Havells India Limited
statement: Continued investment in brand building, innovation and distribution reach during tough periods; long-term orientation over quarter-to-quarter thinking
quote: I would rather say quarter -to-quarter thinking would not be in our mind, more of how do we continue to invest for the long term.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote supports long-term investment mindset over quarter-to-quarter thinking.

name: Havells India Limited
statement: Medium-term target of 2+ percentage point margin improvement unchanged; driven by operating leverage, innovation and premium products
quote: No, that remains as is because we are continuing to wanting to be more efficient, get operating leverage out of better volumes. See, the whole investment behind innovation and brand building would be to put in more innovative products at a premium to the consumer and hence, get better margins for the company.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms medium-term margin improvement target and drivers remain unchanged.
